University Timetable Organizer and Conflict Detector

Project Description

This project is a Python program that helps university students organize their weekly class schedules and detect overlapping classes.

Features

* Enter classes from Sunday to Thursday.
* Enter course codes and class times.
* Validate time using the 24-hour format.
* Display the weekly timetable.
* Detect overlapping classes.
* Display a conflict report.

Project Files

* Our_code.py: Original group code.
* Copilot_code.py: Code generated by GitHub Copilot.
* Improved_copilot code.py: Improved version of the Copilot code.
* Comparison_report.md: Code comparison and testing results.
* GitHubcopilot prompts: Prompts used with GitHub Copilot.

Programming Language

Python
